notes.title: Some brand-new screenshots from American Airport Simulator ✈️
notes.notes:
Hey, future airport managers! 

It's been a while since we shared some updates about the current progress of the development. Rest assured, we've been working hard to prepare some brand-new content that we can share with you. And guess what? Today, we have some fresh screenshots that we're more than happy to present. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43913954/b14246d9c468375410e9d21523e18d587e2da054.jpg[/img]

American Airport Simulator is an engaging and immersive simulation game that puts you in control of managing a bustling airport in the United States. The game offers an authentic experience that challenges players to handle the complexities of running a modern airport efficiently and effectively.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43913954/77eba0212eabc644e2fdfcd6a6f7e692c50b58dc.jpg[/img]

As the airport manager, you'll take charge of every aspect of airport operations, from designing the layout to overseeing day-to-day activities. The game provides a realistic and detailed environment, featuring a variety of aircraft, buildings, and ground vehicles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43913954/d46ff18c1ee0e074ac2e1c7856cd5123c4839ba1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43913954/36ec4dae8c711af3b381d794fcef294f1a97c989.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43913954/2296e300874fcaa037bddb541b887d5c7afcc75a.jpg[/img]

If you're a huge airplanes fan, you might be interested in our two other titles that we have in portfolio – Gas Station Simulator and it's recently released Airstrip DLC, as well as Airport Contraband.

For those of you who are not familiar with those titles, Airstrip DLC brings a new layer of gameplay to Gas Station Simulator, as right now you can have your own small airstrip next to your thriving gas station business. The DLC brings a unique blend of tasks, challenges, and rewards that will keep players engaged for hours.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2137370/Gas_Station_Simulator__Airstrip_DLC/

As for the Airport Contraband, players will experience a work hardships of the airplane personel. However,  if you looked carefully, the game took a little different approach than it was initially planned, but more on that can be found on the brand-new Airport Contraband’s Steam page.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1167820/Airport_Contraband/

And that's it for today, folks! Oh... One more thing - if you have any ideas, suggestions, or general feedback regarding the game, make sure to leave your answers in the comment section below.

notes.title: American Airport Simulator Announcement
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43913954/798e8a3ecc6877ec05b529eb016c69f276a538c6.jpg[/img]

Welcome Airport Managers!

We are proud to present to you Codebusters Studio’s second game we are going to publish: American Airport Simulator. A game where it’s all about turning an old military airfield into an private airport near Aspen. 
Renovating, rebuilding, expanding, maintaining, hiring and all the other exciting activities you love in simulator-type games are going to be at your disposal and so much more. 

Watch the awesome announcement trailer made by the team:

[previewyoutube=iJHQCEz-35w;full][/previewyoutube]

Yes, it’s going to be that good :) So don’t hesitate and add it to your wishlist here on Steam right away.

American Airport Simulator is being developed alongside [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2334600/Farm_Simulator/]Farm Simulator[/url] at Codebusters by two separate teams, so both games will be created at the same time. The game is still deep in its development and it will be a while until you can get your hands on it. But if you need some airport and plane related action a bit sooner, take a look at the Airstrip DLC for Gas Station Simulator coming later this month:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2137370/Gas_Station_Simulator__Airstrip_DLC/

And if Airstrip isn’t anything for you, we are also slowly but surely working on our Airport Contraband. It’s less about the building and running an airport and more about the security aspect of it and smuggling of contraband:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1167820/Airport_Contraband/
